subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: Launched in 1994 with World Bank and other external funding, this centrally sponsored scheme aimed to universalise primary education in educationally backward districts through decentralised planning, teacher training, and infrastructure improvement — it was a direct precursor to the later Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan. It is known as the:
explanation: DPEP (1994) piloted district-level, externally-funded primary education reforms before being subsumed into the broader Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (2001) — distinct from Operation Blackboard (1987, which focused specifically on providing minimum physical facilities/teaching aids to primary schools).
